sc: 10-year-old, sore throat 3 weeks ago, flitting arthritis of large joints, apical pansystolic murmur → ARF with carditis
Girl with clumsy jerky movements, emotional, normal ESR → Sydenham chorea
RHD child with a new murmur and 2 weeks of fever → Infective endocarditis: 3 blood cultures
f: Carditis · arthritis (poly, mono or polyarthralgia in high-risk areas) · chorea · erythema marginatum · subcutaneous nodules
Fever ≥ 38 °C · ESR ≥ 30 / CRP ≥ 3 · prolonged PR · monoarthralgia · plus evidence of strep (ASO, anti-DNase B)
ASO · ESR/CRP · ECG (PR) · echocardiography with Doppler (best for carditis) · throat swab
Penicillin (eradicate strep) · aspirin 50–80 mg/kg/day (arthritis responds in 48 h) · severe carditis: prednisolone 2 mg/kg/day · chorea: haloperidol
Benzathine penicillin every 4 weeks (600 000 U < 27 kg, 1.2 MU ≥ 27 kg) · 5 yr/to 21 yr without carditis, 10 yr/to 40 yr with RHD
Mitral regurgitation (commonest) · mitral stenosis (opening snap, diastolic rumble) · aortic regurgitation · balloon valvotomy for MS
trap: Fever, ESR and prolonged PR are minor, not major · arthralgia cannot count as minor when arthritis is major · chorea may come alone, months later with normal ESR · Carey Coombs = mid-diastolic murmur of acute carditis
